item.title: Why Universalism Doesn't Pass the Sniff Test
item.description: Universalism is not a new theology. It is largely based on verses such as 1 Corinthians 15:14-22 - verse 22: For as in Adam all die, so also in Christ shall all be made alive.And Romans 5:12-18 - verse 18: Therefore, as one trespass led to condemnation for all men, so one act of righteousness leads to justification and life for all men.
